name: com.solidcore.coroutines
description: Zero-allocation, struct-based coroutine scheduler for Unity — a single-threaded runner and a multi-threaded job system that tick thousands of coroutines with no GC. Yield.Do/Yield.WaitUntil take ordinary managed delegates (IL2CPP/Mono-compatible). Standalone: depends only on the bundled SolidCore.Burst and SolidCore.Collections.
author: Aaron Grincewicz
